documented_probe: Overall bucket is hard (sum 21) from the chained emulated-guest pipeline: author a tool ISO, inject a boot init that mounts the cdrom and the 9p host root, boot a real kernel under software-only QEMU TCG (no KVM), compile and run a statically-linked inline-assembly program inside the guest to an exact exit status, drive a no-password serial login, leave the emulator running as a background service, and generalize across genuinely different hidden scenarios. C-9e0d7397 (system-call/file-io emulation) has a 'hard' reference floor; here the guest reaches the host filesystem through the 9p shared host-root mount so host-fs syscall writes are more direct than a from-scratch syscall interpreter, so that one competency is intentionally easier than its floor while the other four meet or exceed their medium floors.
notes: All five competencies are exercised for real in a live emulated guest. Difficulty comes from dependent emulation stages (ISO -> boot -> cdrom mount -> in-guest compile -> login), background-service/serial-interaction statefulness, headless-Guest failure diagnosis, and exact correctness (exit status integer, exact payload string in the ISO manifest echoed over the console). matches the hard bucket; documented_probe explains the single sub-floor competency.
